page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. The virtual machine runs on x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T34 processors clocked at 3.4 GHz, providing 64 dedicated virtual CPUs. System memory is configured at 128.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The server does not feature GPU acceleration.

This server type does not include local disk storage, necessitating the attachment of cloud storage volumes for operating system and data requirements. Baseline network throughput is provisioned at 32 Gbps, supporting high-throughput external connectivity. The instance is allocated zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, which requires network address translation or Elastic IP assignment for external access.

The dense 64-core dedicated AMD compute footprint is engineered for processing-heavy workloads that do not demand extensive RAM per core. Common deployment scenarios include distributed batch compute pipelines, software build and CI/CD clusters, video encoding, static or high-traffic web serving fleets, and general scientific computing simulations.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8ae.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor with an x86_64 architecture. The server does not incorporate GPUs and provides no integrated local disk storage, relying on network-attached storage for persistence. Network capabilities include a 32 Gbps baseline network bandwidth without complimentary public IPv4 addressing. The configuration yields significant compute capacity suited for parallel processing tasks rather than memory-heavy footprints. The instance fits computational workloads such as large-scale compilation, high-throughput web serving, batch processing pipelines, video encoding, and distributed data transformation tasks requiring high core counts and standard memory ratios.
